verses.27:19: And as you have released a bird from your hand, so you have let your neighbor go, and you will not catch him.
verses.27:20: Do not pursue him, for he has gone far away, and has escaped like a gazelle from a snare.
verses.27:21: For a wound can be bound up, and for reviling there is reconciliation; but the one who has revealed secrets has lost hope.
verses.27:22: One who winks with the eye devises evil things, and no one will withdraw himself from him.
verses.27:23: Before your eyes he will sweeten your mouth and he will marvel at your words, but afterward he will twist his mouth and in your words he will set a stumbling block.
verses.27:24: I have hated many things, yet I have compared none to him, and the Lord will hate him.
verses.27:25: The one who throws a stone up high throws it upon his own head, and a treacherous blow will deal out wounds.
verses.27:26: The one who digs a pit will fall into it, and the one who sets a snare will be caught in it.
verses.27:27: The one who does evil—it will roll upon him, and he will never know from where it has come to him.
verses.27:28: Mockery and reproach belong to the proud, and vengeance will lie in wait for him like a lion.
verses.27:29: Those who rejoice at the fall of the godly will be caught in a snare, and pain will consume them before their death.
verses.27:30: Resentment and anger, these too are abominations, and a sinful man will hold fast to them.
verses.28:1: The one who takes vengeance will find vengeance from the Lord, and He will surely hold his sins fast.
verses.28:2: Forgive your neighbor a wrong, and then, when you pray, your sins will be released.
verses.28:3: A man harbors anger against another man, and does he seek healing from the Lord?
verses.28:4: He has no mercy on a man like himself, and does he pray for his own sins?
verses.28:5: He himself, being flesh, holds onto a grudge; who will make atonement for his sins?
verses.28:6: Remember the end and stop being hostile; remember decay and death, and remain in the commandments.
verses.28:7: Remember the commandments and do not hold a grudge against your neighbor, and remember the covenant of the Most High, and overlook ignorance.
verses.28:8: Keep away from strife, and you will lessen sins; for a wrathful man will kindle strife,
verses.28:9: and a sinful man will trouble friends, and in the midst of those who are at peace he casts slander.
verses.28:10: According to the fuel of a fire, so it will blaze up; according to a man's strength his wrath will be, and according to his wealth he will raise up his anger, and according to the strengthening of the strife it will blaze up.
verses.28:11: A hurried dispute kindles fire, and hasty strife sheds blood.
verses.28:12: If you blow on a spark, it will blaze up, and if you spit on it, it will be extinguished; and both come out of your mouth.
verses.28:13: Curse the whisperer and the double-tongued, for they have destroyed many who were at peace.
verses.28:14: A third tongue has shaken many and driven them from nation to nation; it has torn down fortified cities and overturned the houses of great men.
verses.28:15: A third tongue has cast out valiant women and deprived them of their labors.
verses.28:16: The one who pays attention to it will never find rest, nor will he dwell in quietness.
verses.28:17: The blow of a whip makes welts, but the blow of a tongue will shatter bones.
verses.28:18: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword, but not as many as those who have fallen because of the tongue.
verses.28:19: Blessed is the one who has been sheltered from it, who has not passed through its wrath, who has not dragged its yoke, and has not been bound in its bonds.
verses.28:20: For its yoke is an iron yoke, and its bonds are bronze bonds.
verses.28:21: Its death is an evil death, and Hades is more profitable than it.
verses.28:22: It will never have power over the godly, and in its flame they will not be burned.
verses.28:23: Those who forsake the Lord will fall into it, and it will blaze up in them and will never be extinguished; it will be sent out against them like a lion, and like a leopard it will ravage them.
verses.28:24: Look, fence your property around with thorns; tie up your silver and gold.
verses.28:25: And make a balance and a weight for your words, and make a door and a bolt for your mouth.
verses.28:26: Take care that you do not somehow slip by it, that you do not fall before one who lies in wait.
verses.29:1: The one who shows mercy will lend to his neighbor, and the one who gives support with his hand keeps the commandments.
verses.29:2: Lend to your neighbor in the time of his need, and in turn repay your neighbor on time.
verses.29:3: Keep your word firm and be trustworthy with him, and at every time you will find what you need.
verses.29:4: Many have regarded a loan as a windfall, and have caused trouble for those who helped them.
verses.29:5: Until he receives it, he will kiss his hand, and concerning his neighbor's money he will lower his voice; and at the time of repayment he will delay the time, and he will pay back words of weariness and blame the time.
verses.29:6: If he is able, he will barely recover half and will count it as a windfall; but if not, he has defrauded him of his money, and he has acquired him as an enemy not for nothing; he will pay back to him curses and insults, and instead of honor he will pay back to him dishonor.
verses.29:7: Many have turned away because of wickedness; they have feared being defrauded for nothing.
verses.29:8: Nevertheless, be patient with a humble person, and you will delay him for almsgiving.
verses.29:9: Because of the commandment, help a needy person, and in view of his lack do not turn him away empty.
verses.29:10: Lose silver for the sake of a brother and a friend, and do not let it rust under the stone to ruin.
verses.29:11: Place your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it will profit you more than gold.
verses.29:12: Lock up almsgiving in your storehouses, and it will deliver you from every affliction.
verses.29:13: Better than a shield of might and better than a spear of strength, it will fight for you against an enemy.
verses.29:14: A good man will stand surety for his neighbor, and the one who has lost shame will abandon him.
verses.29:15: Do not forget the kindnesses of a guarantor, for he has given his life for you.
verses.29:16: A sinner will overturn the goods of a guarantor,
verses.29:17: and one who is ungrateful in mind will forsake his rescuer.
verses.29:18: Suretyship has destroyed many who were prospering and has tossed them like a wave of the sea; it has sent powerful men into exile, and they have wandered among foreign nations.
verses.29:19: A sinner who falls into suretyship and pursues contracts will fall into lawsuits.
verses.29:20: Help your neighbor according to your ability, and watch yourself so that you do not fall.
verses.29:21: The beginning of life is water and bread and clothing, and a house covering indecency.
verses.29:22: Better is the life of a poor person under a shelter of beams than sumptuous foods among strangers.
verses.29:23: With little and with much, be content.
verses.29:24: It is a miserable life from house to house, and where he sojourns he will not open his mouth.
verses.29:25: You will entertain and serve drink for no thanks, and in addition to these things you will hear bitter words:
verses.29:26: "Come forward, sojourner, set a table, and if there is anything in your hand, feed me."
verses.29:27: "Go out, sojourner, from the presence of honor; my brother has come as my guest; there is need of the guest room."
verses.29:28: These things are heavy for a person who has understanding: the rebuke of a household and the reproach of a lender.
verses.30:1: Concerning children. The one who loves his son will continually apply lashes to him, so that he may be glad at his end.
verses.30:2: The one who disciplines his son will benefit from him, and among acquaintances he will boast about him.
verses.30:3: The one who teaches his son will provoke the enemy to jealousy, and before friends he will exult in him.
verses.30:4: His father died, and even so he did not die, for he left behind one like himself after him.
verses.30:5: In his life he saw and was glad, and at his death he was not grieved.
verses.30:6: Against enemies he left behind an avenger, and for friends one who repays favor.
verses.30:7: For the souls of sons he will bind up his wounds, and at every cry his inward parts will be troubled.
verses.30:8: An untamed horse turns out stubborn, and an unrestrained son becomes headstrong.
verses.30:9: Pamper a child, and he will terrify you; play with him, and he will grieve you.
verses.30:10: Do not laugh with him, so that you may not suffer anguish with him, and in the end you will have your teeth set on edge.
verses.30:11: Do not give him authority in youth.
verses.30:12: Bruise his sides while he is a young child, so that he may never become hardened and disobey you.
verses.30:13: Discipline your son and work on him, so that he may not stumble in your disgrace.
verses.30:14: Better is a poor man who is healthy and strong in constitution than a rich man scourged in his body.
verses.30:15: Health and a sound constitution are better than all gold, and a robust body than immeasurable riches.
verses.30:16: There is no wealth better than health of body, and there is no gladness above joy of heart.
verses.30:17: Better is death than a bitter life or a lasting sickness.
verses.30:18: Good things poured out upon a closed mouth are a portion of food placed upon a grave.
verses.30:19: What does a burnt offering benefit an idol? For it will neither eat nor smell at all; so is the one who is driven away by the Lord,
verses.30:20: looking with his eyes and groaning, just like a eunuch embracing a virgin and groaning.
verses.30:21: Do not give your soul to grief, and do not distress yourself in your counsel.
verses.30:22: Gladness of heart is a person's life, and a man's exultation is length of days.
verses.30:23: Love your soul and comfort your heart, and put grief far away from yourself; for grief has killed many, and there is no profit in it.
verses.30:24: Jealousy and anger shorten days, and anxiety brings old age before its time.
verses.30:25: A bright and good heart over delicacies will attend to its food.
verses.31:1: Sleeplessness over wealth wastes away the flesh, and anxiety about it drives away sleep.
verses.31:2: Anxiety of sleeplessness will demand slumber, and a severe sickness will dispel sleep.
verses.31:3: A rich man has labored in gathering riches, and in rest he is filled with his luxuries.
verses.31:4: A poor man has labored in scarcity of livelihood, and in rest he becomes needy.
verses.31:5: The one who loves gold will not be justified, and the one who pursues corruption will himself be filled.
verses.31:6: Many have been given over to downfall for the sake of gold, and their destruction came before their face.
verses.31:7: It is a wooden stumbling block for those who sacrifice to it, and every fool will be caught in it.
verses.31:8: Blessed is a rich man who has been found blameless, and who has not gone after gold.
verses.31:9: Who is he, and we will call him blessed? For he has done wondrous things among his people.
verses.31:10: Who has been tested by it and made perfect? And let it be for boasting. Who was able to transgress and did not transgress, and to do evil things and did not do them?
verses.31:11: His goods will be established, and the assembly will recount his acts of charity.
verses.31:12: Have you sat at a great table? Do not open your throat over it, and do not say, "Many indeed are the things on it!"
verses.31:13: Remember that an evil eye is a bad thing; what has been created more evil than an eye? Therefore it weeps from every face.
verses.31:14: Wherever he looks, do not stretch out your hand, and do not crowd against him in the dish.
verses.31:15: Understand the things of your neighbor from yourself, and reflect on every matter.
verses.31:16: Eat the things set before you like a human being, and do not chew greedily, so that you may not be hated.
verses.31:17: Stop first for the sake of discipline, and do not be insatiable, so that you may never give offense.
verses.31:18: And if you have sat down among many, do not stretch out your hand before them.
verses.31:19: How sufficient is a little for a disciplined person, and on his bed he does not gasp for breath.
verses.31:20: Healthy sleep comes upon a moderate stomach; he rises early, and his soul is with him. The pain of sleeplessness and bilious nausea, and colic, are with an insatiable man.
verses.31:21: And if you have been pressed with delicacies, get up and leave midway, and you will find rest.
verses.31:22: Listen to me, child, and do not despise me, and in the end you will find my words. In all your works be diligent, and no sickness will ever meet you.
verses.31:23: Lips will bless one who is generous with bread, and the testimony to his excellence is trustworthy.
verses.31:24: A city will grumble against one who is stingy with bread, and the testimony to his stinginess is accurate.
verses.31:25: Do not act the hero with wine, for wine has destroyed many.
verses.31:26: A furnace tests tempered steel in the quenching, so wine tests hearts in the strife of the arrogant.
verses.31:27: Wine is equal to life for a person, if you drink it in its measure. What life is there for one lacking in wine? And it has been created for gladness for people.
verses.31:28: Exultation of heart and gladness of soul is wine drunk at the right time in sufficient amount.
verses.31:29: Bitterness of soul is wine drunk in abundance, with provocation and conflict.
verses.31:30: Drunkenness multiplies the anger of a fool to stumbling, diminishing strength and adding wounds.
verses.31:31: At a banquet of wine do not rebuke your neighbor, and do not despise him in his gladness; do not speak a word of reproach to him, and do not distress him with a demand.
verses.32:1: Have they appointed you leader? Do not exalt yourself; be among them as one of them. Take care of them, and then sit down.
verses.32:2: And when you have done all your duty, recline, so that you may be glad because of them and receive a wreath on account of good order.
verses.32:3: Speak, older man, for it is fitting for you, with accurate knowledge, and do not hinder the music.
verses.32:4: Where there is a performance, do not pour out talk, and do not display wisdom at the wrong time.
verses.32:5: A signet of ruby on a gold ornament; such is a concert of music at a banquet of wine.
verses.32:6: In a gold setting, a signet of emerald; such is a melody of music with sweet wine.
verses.32:7: Speak, young man, if there is need of you, scarcely twice if you are asked.
verses.32:8: Sum up your speech, many things in few words; be as one who knows and at the same time keeps silent.
verses.32:9: In the midst of great men do not make yourself an equal, and when another is speaking do not chatter much.
verses.32:10: Before thunder lightning speeds ahead, and before a modest person favor will go ahead.
verses.32:11: Rise up at the right time and do not lag behind; hurry off home and do not loiter.
verses.32:12: There amuse yourself and do what you have in mind, and do not sin with an arrogant word.
verses.32:13: And for these things bless the One who made you and fills you to overflowing from His good things.
verses.32:14: The one who fears the Lord will accept discipline, and those who rise early will find favor.
verses.32:15: The one who seeks the law will be filled with it, and the one who acts hypocritically will stumble over it.
verses.32:16: Those who fear the Lord will find justice, and they will kindle righteous deeds like light.
verses.32:17: A sinful man will turn aside from reproof, and according to his will he will find a ruling.
verses.32:18: A man of counsel will by no means overlook a thought; a stranger and an arrogant man will not cower at fear, even after acting by himself without counsel.
verses.32:19: Without counsel do nothing, and when you have acted, do not feel regret.
verses.32:20: Do not walk on a road of obstacles, and do not stumble in stony places.
verses.32:21: Do not trust in an unobstructed road,
verses.32:22: and guard yourself from your children.
verses.32:23: In every work trust your soul, for indeed this is the keeping of the commandments.
verses.32:24: The one who trusts the law heeds the commandments, and the one who relies on the Lord will not suffer loss.
verses.33:1: Evil will not come upon the one who fears the Lord, but in testing he will be delivered yet again.
verses.33:2: A wise man will not hate the law, but the one who acts hypocritically in it is like a ship in a storm.
verses.33:3: A discerning man will trust in the law, and the law is trustworthy to him like an inquiry of the righteous.
verses.33:4: Prepare your speech and then you will be heard; bind instruction together and answer.
verses.33:5: The heart of a fool is a cart wheel, and his reasoning is like a turning axle.
verses.33:6: A breeding stallion is like a mocking friend; he neighs under everyone who sits on him.
verses.33:7: Why does one day surpass another, when all the daylight of the year is from the sun?
verses.33:8: By the knowledge of the Lord they were distinguished, and He varied seasons and festivals.
verses.33:9: Some of them He exalted and sanctified, and some of them He appointed to the number of days.
verses.33:10: And all people are from the ground, and Adam was created from the earth.
verses.33:11: In the abundance of knowledge the Lord distinguished them and varied their ways.
verses.33:12: Some of them He blessed and exalted, and some of them He sanctified and brought near to Himself; some of them He cursed and brought low, and overturned them from their position.
verses.33:13: As a potter's clay is in his hand, all its ways according to his good pleasure, so are people in the hand of the One who made them, to render to them according to His judgment.
verses.33:14: Opposite evil is good, and opposite death is life; so opposite a godly person is a sinner.
verses.33:15: And in this way look upon all the works of the Most High: two by two, one opposite the other.
verses.33:17: Like one gleaning behind grape-gatherers, by the blessing of the Lord I got ahead,
verses.33:18: and like a grape-gatherer I filled a winepress. Consider that I did not labor for myself alone, but for all who seek instruction.
verses.33:19: Hear me, great men of the people, and leaders of the assembly, give ear.
verses.33:20: To son and wife, brother and friend, do not give authority over yourself in your lifetime; and do not give your possessions to another, so that you do not feel regret and beg for them.
verses.33:21: While you are still alive and breath is in you, do not exchange yourself for any flesh.
verses.33:22: For it is better for your children to beg from you than for you to look to the hands of your sons.
verses.33:23: In all your works be preeminent; do not put a blemish on your honor.
verses.33:24: On the day of the completion of the days of your life, and at the time of death, distribute your inheritance.
verses.33:25: Fodder and a rod and burdens for a donkey; bread and discipline and work for a household servant.
verses.33:26: Put a servant to work, and you will find rest; leave his hands free, and he will seek freedom.
verses.33:27: A yoke and a strap will bend a neck, and for a wicked household servant, racks and tortures.
verses.33:28: Put him to work so that he may not be idle, for idleness teaches much wickedness.
verses.33:29: Set him to tasks as is fitting for him, and if he does not obey, make his shackles heavy.
verses.33:30: And do not go to excess with any flesh, and without judgment do nothing.
verses.33:31: If you have a household servant, let him be like you, because you acquired him with blood.
verses.33:32: If you have a household servant, treat him as yourself, because, like your soul, there is need for him; if you mistreat him and he departs and runs away, on what road will you seek him?
verses.34:1: Empty and false hopes belong to a man without understanding, and dreams give wings to fools.
verses.34:2: Like one grasping a shadow and chasing the wind, so is the one who pays attention to dreams.
verses.34:3: This opposite that is the vision of dreams: the likeness of a face in front of a face.
verses.34:4: From what is unclean, what will be made clean? And from what is false, what will be true?
verses.34:5: Divinations and omens and dreams are futile, and the heart forms fancies like that of a woman in labor.
verses.34:6: Unless they are sent from the Most High in a visitation, do not give your heart to them.
verses.34:7: Dreams have led many astray, and they fell away while hoping in them.
verses.34:8: Without falsehood the law will be fulfilled, and wisdom in a faithful mouth is fulfillment.
verses.34:9: An instructed man knows many things, and one of much experience will declare understanding.
verses.34:10: He who has not been tested knows little, but the one who has traveled will multiply shrewdness.
verses.34:11: I have seen many things in my travels, and my understanding is more than my words.
verses.34:12: Many times I was in danger to the point of death, and I was rescued because of these things.
verses.34:13: The spirit of those who fear the Lord will live, for their hope is upon the One who saves them.
verses.34:14: The one who fears the Lord will never be afraid and will never lose heart, because He Himself is his hope.
verses.34:15: Blessed is the soul of the one who fears the Lord. On whom does he rely? And who is his support?
verses.34:16: The eyes of the Lord are upon those who love Him: a protection of might and a support of strength, a shelter from scorching heat and a shelter from midday, a guard from stumbling and a help from falling.
verses.34:17: He raises up the soul and enlightens the eyes, giving healing, life, and blessing.
verses.34:18: When one sacrifices from what is unjust, the offering is mocked, and the mockeries of the lawless are not pleasing.
verses.34:19: The Most High is not pleased with the offerings of the ungodly, nor by a multitude of sacrifices does He forgive sins.
verses.34:20: One who sacrifices a son before his father is the one who brings a sacrifice from the property of the poor.
verses.34:21: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; the one who withholds it is a man of bloodshed.
verses.34:22: One who murders a neighbor is the one who takes away a livelihood, and one who sheds blood is the one who withholds the wages of a hired worker.
verses.34:23: When one builds and one tears down, what have they gained more than toil?
verses.34:24: When one prays and one curses, whose voice will the Master hear?
verses.34:25: If one washes himself from a dead body and touches it again, what has he gained by his washing?
verses.34:26: So is a man who fasts for his sins and goes again and does the same things: who will hear his prayer? And what has he gained by humbling himself?
verses.35:1: The one who keeps the law multiplies offerings; the one who pays heed to the commandments sacrifices a deliverance offering.
verses.35:2: One who repays a kindness offers fine flour, and the one who gives alms sacrifices a praise offering.
verses.35:3: The good pleasure of the Lord is to turn away from wickedness, and atonement is to turn away from injustice.
verses.35:4: Do not appear before the face of the Lord empty-handed, for all these things are because of the commandment.
verses.35:5: The offering of a righteous person enriches the altar, and its fragrant aroma is before the Most High.
verses.35:6: The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable, and its memorial will not be forgotten.
verses.35:7: With a generous eye glorify the Lord, and do not diminish the firstfruits of your hands.
verses.35:8: In every gift make your face cheerful, and with gladness consecrate a tithe.
verses.35:9: Give to the Most High according to His gift, and with a generous eye according to what your hand finds.
verses.35:10: For the Lord is One who repays, and He will repay you sevenfold.
verses.35:12: Do not offer a bribe, for He will not accept it; and do not rely on an unjust sacrifice, because the Lord is a judge, and with Him there is no partiality.
verses.35:13: He will not show partiality against a poor person, and He will hear the plea of one who has been wronged.
verses.35:14: He will never disregard the supplication of an orphan, nor a widow when she pours out her words.
verses.35:15: Do not the tears of a widow run down her cheek, and is not the outcry against the one who brought them down?
verses.35:16: One who serves with good pleasure will be accepted, and his plea will reach to the clouds.
verses.35:17: The prayer of the humble has pierced the clouds, and until it draws near, it will never be consoled; and it will never depart until the Most High visits,
verses.35:21: and judges righteously and executes judgment. And the Lord will never delay, nor will He be patient with them, until He crushes the loins of the merciless and repays vengeance to the nations; until He removes the multitude of the insolent and crushes the scepters of the unjust;
verses.35:22: until He repays a man according to his deeds, and the works of men according to their intentions; until He judges the cause of His people and gladdens them with His mercy.
verses.35:24: Timely is mercy in a time of his distress, like clouds of rain in a time of drought.
verses.36:1: Have mercy on us, Master, the God of all, and look, and cast the fear of You upon all the nations.
verses.36:2: Lift up Your hand against foreign nations, and let them see Your might.
verses.36:3: Just as in their sight You were shown holy in us, so in our sight may You be magnified in them.
verses.36:4: And let them know You, just as we also have come to know that there is no God besides You, Lord.
verses.36:5: Renew signs and make other wonders;
verses.36:6: glorify Your hand and right arm; rouse fury and pour out wrath; remove the adversary and wipe out the enemy.
verses.36:7: Hasten the time and remember the oath, and let them declare Your mighty deeds.
verses.36:8: In the wrath of fire let the survivor be devoured, and may those who wrong Your people find destruction.
verses.36:9: Crush the heads of enemy rulers who say, "There is no one besides us."
verses.36:10: Gather all the tribes of Jacob. And I was the last to keep watch; and You will give them an inheritance, just as from the beginning.
verses.36:11: Have mercy on the people, Lord, called by Your name, and on Israel, whom You likened to a firstborn.
verses.36:12: Have compassion on the city of Your sanctuary, Jerusalem, the city of Your rest.
verses.36:13: Fill Zion with the proclamation of Your wonders, and Your people with Your glory.
verses.36:14: Give testimony to Your creatures from the beginning, and raise up the prophecies that are in Your name.
verses.36:15: Give a reward to those who wait for You, and let Your prophets be proved trustworthy.
verses.36:16: Hear, Lord, the plea of Your suppliants according to the blessing of Aaron concerning Your people, and all those upon the earth will know that You are the Lord, the God of the ages.
verses.36:18: The stomach will eat any food, yet one food is finer than another.
verses.36:19: The palate tastes foods of wild game; so an understanding heart tastes false words.
verses.36:20: A crooked heart will cause grief, and a man of much experience will repay him.
verses.36:21: A woman will accept any man, yet one daughter is better than another.
verses.36:22: The beauty of a woman cheers the face and surpasses every desire of a man.
verses.36:23: If mercy and gentleness are upon her tongue, her husband is not like the sons of men.
verses.36:24: The one who acquires a wife makes a beginning of property, a helper corresponding to him and a pillar of rest.
verses.36:25: Where there is no fence, property will be plundered; and where there is no wife, one will groan while wandering.
verses.36:26: For who will trust a nimble robber straying from city to city? So it is with a man who has no nest and lodges wherever evening overtakes him.
verses.37:1: Every friend will say, "I too became a friend to him"; but there is a friend who is a friend in name only.
verses.37:2: Is not a companion and friend turning to enmity a grief even to death?
verses.37:3: O evil imagination, from where were you rolled in to cover the dry land with deceit?
verses.37:4: A companion takes delight in a friend's gladness, and in a time of affliction he will be in opposition.
verses.37:5: A companion labors together with a friend for the sake of the belly; in the face of war he will take up a shield.
verses.37:6: Do not forget a friend in your soul, and do not be unmindful of him in your wealth.
verses.37:7: Every counselor extols counsel, but there is one who gives counsel for himself.
verses.37:8: Guard your soul from a counselor, and know first what his need is—for indeed he will take counsel for himself—for fear that he may cast a lot against you,
verses.37:9: and say to you, "Your way is good," and he will stand opposite to see what will happen to you.
verses.37:10: Do not take counsel with the one who looks suspiciously at you, and hide counsel from those who are jealous of you:
verses.37:11: with a woman concerning her rival, and with a coward about war, and with a merchant about trade, and with a buyer about a sale, with an envious person about gratitude, and with a merciless person about kindness, with a lazy person about any work, and with a nonresident hired worker about completion, an idle household servant about much labor—do not rely on these for any counsel.
verses.37:12: Rather, associate continually with a godly man, whom you recognize as keeping commandments, who in his soul is like your soul, and if you stumble, he will grieve with you.
verses.37:13: And establish the counsel of your heart, for there is no one more faithful to you than it.
verses.37:14: For a man's soul is sometimes accustomed to report better than seven watchmen sitting on a high place at a lookout.
verses.37:15: And above all these things, pray to the Most High that He may make your way straight in truth.
verses.37:16: The beginning of every work is a word, and before every action is counsel.
verses.37:17: A trace of change is in the heart;
verses.37:18: four parts spring up: good and evil, life and death, and what continually rules over them is the tongue.
verses.37:19: There is a man who is shrewd and an instructor of many, yet to his own soul he is useless.
verses.37:20: There is one who acts wise in words and is hated; this one will lack all food.
verses.37:21: For grace was not given to him from the Lord, because he was deprived of all wisdom.
verses.37:22: There is one who is wise for his own soul, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy upon his mouth.
verses.37:23: A wise man will instruct his own people, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.
verses.37:24: A wise man will be filled with blessing, and all who see him will call him blessed.
verses.37:25: The life of a man is in a number of days, and the days of Israel are innumerable.
verses.37:26: The wise man will inherit trust among his people, and his name will live forever.
verses.37:27: Child, in your life test your soul, and see what is bad for it, and do not give that to it.
verses.37:28: For not all things are beneficial for all, and not every soul takes pleasure in everything.
verses.37:29: Do not be insatiable in any luxury, and do not pour yourself out over foods.
verses.37:30: For in many foods there will be pain, and insatiability will draw near to colic.
verses.37:31: Because of insatiability many have died, but the one who takes heed will add life.
verses.38:1: Honor a physician according to the needs with the honors due him, for indeed the Lord created him.
verses.38:2: For healing is from the Most High, and from a king he will receive a gift.
verses.38:3: The skill of a physician will lift up his head, and before great men he will be admired.
verses.38:4: The Lord created medicines from the earth, and a sensible man will not despise them.
verses.38:5: Was not water made sweet by wood so that His power might be known?
verses.38:6: And He Himself gave skill to people so that He might be glorified in His marvelous works.
verses.38:7: With them he heals and takes away his pain,
verses.38:8: with these a pharmacist will make a compound; and He will never bring His works to an end, and peace is from Him upon the face of the earth.
verses.38:9: Child, in your illness do not be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and He Himself will heal you.
verses.38:10: Put away wrongdoing and make your hands straight, and cleanse your heart from all sin.
verses.38:11: Give a fragrant aroma and a memorial of fine flour, and make an offering rich, as one who does not exist.
verses.38:12: And give a place to a physician, for indeed the Lord created him; and let him not depart from you, for indeed there is need of him.
verses.38:13: There is a time when success is also in their hands,
verses.38:14: for indeed they themselves will pray to the Lord that He may grant them success in relief and healing for the sake of continued life.
verses.38:15: May the one who sins before Him who made him fall into the hands of a physician.
verses.38:16: Child, shed tears over a dead person, and as one suffering grievously begin a lamentation; according to his due shroud his body, and do not neglect his burial.
verses.38:17: Make weeping bitter and make wailing fervent, and observe the mourning according to his worth, one day and two because of slander, and then be comforted because of grief.
verses.38:18: For from grief death comes forth, and grief of heart will bend strength.
verses.38:19: In being carried off, grief also passes by, and the life of a poor person is against the heart.
verses.38:20: Do not give your heart to grief; put it away, remembering the end.
verses.38:21: Do not forget, for there is no return; and you will not benefit this one, and you will harm yourself.
verses.38:22: Remember that his judgment is thus, just as yours is also: "For me yesterday, and for you today."
verses.38:23: In the rest of a dead person, put his remembrance to rest, and be comforted concerning him at the departure of his spirit.
verses.38:24: The wisdom of a scribe is in the opportunity of leisure, and the one who is reduced in his business will become wise.
verses.38:25: How will he become wise who holds the plow and boasts in the shaft of a goad, driving oxen and occupied in their works, and their talk is about sons of bulls?
verses.38:26: He will give his heart to turning out furrows, and his wakefulness is for the fodder of heifers.
verses.38:27: So also is every craftsman and master builder who passes his time by night as by day; those who engrave engravings of signets, and his perseverance is to vary the pattern; he will give his heart to making a painting lifelike, and his wakefulness is to complete the work.
verses.38:28: So also is the smith sitting near the anvil and closely examining unworked iron; the vapor of fire will harden his flesh, and in the heat of the furnace he will contend; the sound of the hammer will renew his ear, and his eyes are opposite the model of the vessel; he will give his heart to the completion of works, and his wakefulness is to adorn them at completion.
verses.38:29: So also is the potter sitting at his work and turning a wheel with his feet, who is continually in anxiety over his work, and all his labor is counted by number.
verses.38:30: With his arm he will mold clay, and before his feet he will bend its strength; he will apply his heart to complete the gift, and his wakefulness is to clean the kiln.
verses.38:31: All these have trusted in their hands, and each one is wise in his own work.
verses.38:32: Without them a city will not be inhabited, and people will neither sojourn nor walk about.
verses.38:33: And in the assembly they will not rise to prominence, and they will not understand a covenant of judgment; they will not sit on a judge's seat, nor will they declare righteousness and judgment, and they will not be found among proverbs;
verses.38:34: but they will preserve the creation of the age, and their prayer is in the work of a craft. Not so with the one who applies his soul and reflects on the law of the Most High,
verses.39:1: He will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients, and he will be occupied with prophecies.
verses.39:2: He will preserve the discourses of renowned men, and he will enter into the subtleties of parables.
verses.39:3: He will seek out the hidden things of proverbs, and he will be conversant with the riddles of parables.
verses.39:4: He will serve among great men, and he will appear before a ruler; he will travel through the land of foreign nations, for he has tested good and evil among people.
verses.39:5: He will devote his heart to rise early to the Lord who made him, and before the Most High he will make supplication; and he will open his mouth in prayer, and for his sins he will make supplication.
verses.39:6: If the great Lord wills, he will be filled with a spirit of understanding; he himself will pour forth words of wisdom, and in prayer he will give thanks to the Lord.
verses.39:7: He himself will direct his counsel and knowledge, and he will reflect on His hidden things.
verses.39:8: He himself displays the instruction of his teaching, and he will boast in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.39:9: Many will praise his understanding; it will not be blotted out forever. His memorial will not depart, and his name will live for generations of generations.
verses.39:10: Nations will recount his wisdom, and the assembly will proclaim his praise.
verses.39:11: If he remains, he will leave a greater name than a thousand; and if he rests, it suffices for him.
verses.39:12: Yet again, having reflected, I will speak forth, and like a full moon I have been filled.
verses.39:13: Listen to me, devout sons, and sprout like a rose growing beside a stream of the field,
verses.39:14: and like frankincense emit a sweet fragrance, and put forth a blossom like a lily; spread fragrance abroad and sing a song of praise. Bless the Lord for all the works,
verses.39:15: give greatness to His name, and give thanks in His praise, with songs of the lips and with lyres; and in this way you will say in thanksgiving:
verses.39:16: "All the works of the Lord are indeed very good, and every command will come about in its time.
verses.39:17: One cannot say, 'What is this? What is this for?' for everything will be sought out in its time. At His word water stood like a heap, and at the utterance of His mouth, reservoirs of waters.
verses.39:18: At His command is all good pleasure, and there is no one who will diminish His salvation.
verses.39:19: The works of all flesh are before Him, and it is not possible to be hidden from His eyes.
verses.39:20: From eternity to eternity He looks on, and nothing is marvelous before Him.
verses.39:21: One cannot say, 'What is this? What is this for?' for all things have been created for their uses.
verses.39:22: His blessing covered over like a river, and like a flood it drenched the dry land.
verses.39:23: So nations will inherit His wrath, just as He turned waters into brine.
verses.39:24: His ways are straight for the devout; so for the lawless they are stumbling blocks.
verses.39:25: Good things have been created for the good from the beginning; so evil things for sinners.
verses.39:26: The chief of every need for human life is water, fire, iron, salt, fine flour, wheat, honey, milk, the blood of the grape, oil, and clothing.
verses.39:27: All these things are for good to the godly; so to sinners they will be turned to evil.
verses.39:28: There are spirits that have been created for vengeance, and in their fury they strengthened their scourges; and in the time of consummation they will pour out strength, and they will appease the fury of the One who made them.
verses.39:29: Fire and hail and famine and death—all these have been created for vengeance.
verses.39:30: The teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions and vipers, and a sword taking vengeance on the ungodly to destruction—
verses.39:31: at His commandment they will rejoice, and on the earth they will be prepared for uses, and in their times they will not transgress a word."
verses.39:32: Therefore from the beginning I was firmly established, and I reflected, and I left it in writing.
verses.39:33: All the works of the Lord are good, and He will supply every need in its hour.
verses.39:34: And one cannot say, "This is worse than that," for all things will be approved in due time.
verses.39:35: And now with all heart and mouth we have sung praise, and bless the name of the Lord.
verses.40:1: Great toil has been created for every person, and a heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day of coming forth from their mother's womb until the day for burial into the mother of all—
verses.40:2: their thoughts and fear of heart, contemplation of expectation, the day of death—
verses.40:3: from the one sitting on a throne in glory even to the one humbled in earth and ashes,
verses.40:4: from the one wearing blue-purple and a crown even to the one clothed in raw linen:
verses.40:5: fury and jealousy and turmoil and agitation and fear of death and resentment and strife. And in the time of rest on a bed, the sleep of night alters his knowledge.
verses.40:6: Little, as nothing, is he in rest, and from then on in sleep he is as on a day of watch, troubled in the vision of his heart like one who has escaped from the face of battle;
verses.40:7: at the time of his deliverance he wakes up, and marvels that there is no fear.
verses.40:8: With all flesh, from human to beast, and upon sinners sevenfold in addition to these:
verses.40:9: death and blood and strife and sword—
verses.40:10: for the lawless all these things were created, and because of them the flood came about.
verses.40:11: All things that are from earth return to earth, and what is from waters turns back to the sea.
verses.40:12: Every bribe and injustice will be blotted out, and faithfulness will stand forever.
verses.40:13: The wealth of the unjust will dry up like a river, and like great thunder in rain it will resound.
verses.40:14: When he opens his hands he will rejoice; so those who transgress will come to a complete end.
verses.40:15: The offspring of the ungodly will not multiply branches, and unclean roots are upon sheer rock.
verses.40:16: Reed grass beside every water and riverbank will be plucked up before all grass.
verses.40:17: Kindness is like a garden in blessings, and almsgiving will endure forever.
verses.40:18: The life of a self-sufficient laborer will be sweet, and above both is the one who finds a treasure.
verses.40:19: Children and the building of a city establish a name, and above both a blameless wife is esteemed.
verses.40:20: Wine and music gladden the heart, and above both is the love of wisdom.
verses.40:21: Flute and harp make melodies pleasant, and above both is a pleasant tongue.
verses.40:22: Your eye will desire grace and beauty, and above both, the green shoots of a crop.
verses.40:23: A friend and a companion meet at the right time, and above both is a wife with a husband.
verses.40:24: Brothers and help are for a time of distress, and above both, almsgiving will deliver.
verses.40:25: Gold and silver will make the foot stand firm, and above both a wife is approved.
verses.40:26: Wealth and strength will lift up the heart, and above both is the fear of the Lord. There is no lack in the fear of the Lord, and in it there is no need to seek help.
verses.40:27: The fear of the Lord is like a garden of blessing, and above all glory they have covered it.
verses.40:28: Child, do not live a life of begging; it is better to die than to beg.
verses.40:29: A man looking to another's table—his living is not in the reckoning of life; he will pollute his soul with another's foods. But a knowledgeable and instructed man will guard himself.
verses.40:30: In the mouth of a shameless person begging will be sweet, and in his belly a fire will burn.
verses.41:1: O death, how bitter is the remembrance of you to a person living at peace in his possessions, to a man free from distraction and prospering in all things, and still having strength to receive food!
verses.41:2: O death, your sentence is good to a person who is in need and diminishing in strength, in extreme old age and distracted about all things, and who is disobedient and has lost endurance.
verses.41:3: Do not fear the sentence of death; remember those before you and those after; this is the sentence from the Lord for all flesh,
verses.41:4: and why do you reject the good pleasure of the Most High? Whether ten, or a hundred, or a thousand years, there is no inquiry about life in Hades.
verses.41:5: The children of sinners become abominable children, and those who frequent the dwellings of the ungodly;
verses.41:6: the inheritance of the children of sinners will perish, and with their offspring reproach will remain continually.
verses.41:7: Children will blame an ungodly father, because on account of him they will be reproached.
verses.41:8: Woe to you, ungodly men, who have forsaken the law of God the Most High;
verses.41:9: and if you are born, you will be born to a curse, and if you die, you will be apportioned to a curse.
verses.41:10: All things that are from earth will depart to earth; so the ungodly go from a curse to destruction.
verses.41:11: The mourning of people is over their bodies, but the name of sinners, which is not good, will be blotted out.
verses.41:12: Have concern for a name, for it will endure for you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold;
verses.41:13: a good life has a number of days, and a good name will endure forever.
verses.41:14: Preserve discipline in peace, children; but hidden wisdom and unseen treasure, what benefit is there in both?
verses.41:15: Better is a person who hides his folly than a person who hides his wisdom.
verses.41:16: Therefore, feel shame in accordance with my word; for it is not good to keep every kind of shame, and not all things are approved by all in faithfulness.
verses.41:17: Be ashamed before father and mother of sexual immorality, and before a leader and a mighty one of a lie,
verses.41:18: before a judge and a ruler of an offense, before an assembly and a people of lawlessness, before a partner and a friend of injustice, and before the place where you dwell of theft,
verses.41:19: and before the truth of God and the covenant, and of leaning an elbow on the bread, of scorn in receiving and giving,
verses.41:20: and before those who greet you of silence, of looking at a prostitute,
verses.41:21: and of turning away the face of a relative, of taking away a portion and a gift, and of looking intently at a married woman,
verses.41:22: of meddling with his maidservant, and do not approach her bed; before friends of words of reproach, and after giving do not reproach;
verses.41:23: of repetition and of a word heard, and of revelations of hidden words;
verses.42:1: Do not be ashamed about these things, and do not show partiality so as to sin:
verses.42:2: about the law of the Most High and the covenant, and about judgment to acquit the ungodly,
verses.42:3: about an accounting with a partner and travelers, about the giving of an inheritance of companions,
verses.42:4: about accuracy of scales and weights, about acquiring much and little,
verses.42:5: about indifference in selling and with merchants, and about much discipline of children, and making the side of a wicked servant bleed;
verses.42:6: over a wicked wife a seal is good, and where there are many hands, lock up;
verses.42:7: whatever you hand over, let it be by number and weight, and giving and receiving for everyone in writing;
verses.42:8: about the discipline of a senseless person and a fool, and of one in extreme old age who contends with the young; and you will be truly disciplined and approved before every living one.
verses.42:9: A daughter is a secret sleeplessness to a father, and anxiety over her drives away sleep: in her youth, for fear that she may pass her prime, and when married, for fear that she may be hated;
verses.42:10: in virginity, for fear that she may be defiled and become pregnant in her father's house; when with a husband, for fear that she may transgress, and when married, for fear that she may be barren.
verses.42:11: Over a headstrong daughter strengthen the watch, so that she may not make you a laughingstock to enemies, talk in the city and a public summons of the people, and she will put you to shame in a crowd of many.
verses.42:12: Do not gaze at any person for beauty, and do not sit in the midst of women;
verses.42:13: for from garments a moth comes out, and from a woman, the wickedness of a woman.
verses.42:14: Better is the wickedness of a man than a woman who does good, and a woman who brings shame to reproach.
verses.42:15: Now I will remember the works of the Lord, and what I have seen I will recount; by the words of the Lord are His works.
verses.42:16: The shining sun looks upon all things, and His work is full of His glory.
verses.42:17: The Lord has not enabled the holy ones to recount all His wonders, which the Lord Almighty established, for the universe to be made firm in His glory.
verses.42:18: He has searched out the abyss and the heart, and I have reflected on their cunning devices; for the Lord knows all knowledge and has looked into the sign of the age,
verses.42:19: declaring the things that have passed and the things that are to come, and revealing the traces of secret things;
verses.42:20: no thought has passed Him by, not even one word has been hidden from Him.
verses.42:21: He has set in order the great works of His wisdom; and as long as He exists, before the age and forever, He has neither been added to nor diminished, and He has not needed any counselor.
verses.42:22: How desirable are all His works, and like a spark they are to look upon!
verses.42:23: All these things live and remain forever in all needs, and all things obey;
verses.42:24: all things are twofold, one opposite the other, and He has made nothing incomplete;
verses.42:25: one establishes the good things of the other, and who will be satisfied seeing His glory?
verses.43:1: The pride of the height is the expanse of purity, the appearance of heaven in a vision of glory.
verses.43:2: The sun, in its appearing, proclaiming at its going out, is a marvelous vessel, a work of the Most High.
verses.43:3: At its noon it dries up the land, and before its heat, who will endure?
verses.43:4: One tends a furnace in works of heat; three times more the sun burns up mountains, breathing out fiery vapors, and shining out rays, it dims the eyes.
verses.43:5: Great is the Lord who made it, and by His words He hastened its course.
verses.43:6: And the moon in all things is at its appointed time, an indication of times and an everlasting sign.
verses.43:7: From the moon is the sign of a festival, a luminary waning upon completion.
verses.43:8: The month is according to its name, increasing marvelously in its changing; a vessel of parables in the height, shining out in the expanse of heaven.
verses.43:9: The beauty of heaven is the glory of the stars, an illuminating ornament; in the highest places is the Lord.
verses.43:10: By holy words they will stand according to judgment, and they will never grow weary in their watches.
verses.43:11: Look at the rainbow, and bless Him who made it; it is exceedingly beautiful in its radiance.
verses.43:12: It encircled heaven in a circle of glory; the hands of the Most High stretched it out.
verses.43:13: By His command He caused the snow to cease, and He speeds the lightnings of His judgment.
verses.43:14: Therefore storehouses were opened, and clouds flew out like birds.
verses.43:15: In His majesty He strengthened the clouds, and stones of hail were shattered.
verses.43:16: And at His appearings mountains will be shaken; by His will the south wind will blow.
verses.43:17: The voice of His thunder reproached the earth, as did a tempest of the north and a whirling of wind. Like birds flying down He sprinkles snow, and like a locust settling down is its descent.
verses.43:18: At the beauty of its whiteness the eye will marvel, and at its rain the heart will be astonished.
verses.43:19: And He pours out frost like salt upon the earth, and when frozen, it becomes the points of thorns.
verses.43:20: A cold north wind will blow, and ice will freeze from water; upon every gathering of water it will settle, and the water will clothe itself as with a breastplate.
verses.43:21: It will devour mountains and burn up the wilderness, and it will extinguish greenery like fire.
verses.43:22: A healing of all things in haste is a mist; dew arriving after scorching heat will bring cheer.
verses.43:23: By His counsel He stilled the abyss, and Jesus planted it.
verses.43:24: Those who sail the sea recount its danger, and at the hearing of our ears we marvel.
verses.43:25: And there are extraordinary and marvelous works, a variety of every living creature, the creation of sea monsters.
verses.43:26: Because of Him a sweet aroma is His end, and by His word all things hold together.
verses.43:27: We will say many things and will never reach the end, and the conclusion of words is: "He is all."
verses.43:28: In glorifying Him, where will we have strength? For He is the Great One beyond all His works.
verses.43:29: Awesome is the Lord and exceedingly great, and marvelous is His might.
verses.43:30: Glorifying the Lord, exalt Him as much as you are able, for He will surpass even more; and exalting Him, increase in strength; do not grow weary, for you will never reach the end.
verses.43:31: Who has seen Him and will describe Him? And who will magnify Him as He is?
verses.43:32: Many hidden things are greater than these, for we have seen few of His works.
verses.43:33: For the Lord made all things, and to the godly He gave wisdom.
verses.44:1: Hymn of the fathers. Let us now praise glorious men and our fathers by descent.
verses.44:2: The Lord created much glory, His majesty from eternity.
verses.44:3: Those ruling in their kingdoms, and men renowned in power; they will take counsel in their understanding, having declared in prophecies;
verses.44:4: leaders of the people in counsels and in understanding of the learning of the people, wise words in their instruction;
verses.44:5: those seeking out melodies of music, recounting verses in writing;
verses.44:6: wealthy men furnished with strength, living in peace in their dwellings.
verses.44:7: All these were glorified among generations, and in their days they were a boast.
verses.44:8: There are some of them who left behind a name for declaring praises,
verses.44:9: and there are some of whom there is no memorial, and they perished as though they had not existed, and became as though they had never been, and their children after them.
verses.44:10: But rather, these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds were not forgotten.
verses.44:11: With their offspring a good inheritance will endure, their descendants. In the covenants
verses.44:12: their offspring stood firm, and their children because of them.
verses.44:13: Forever their offspring will remain, and their glory will not be blotted out.
verses.44:14: Their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives for generations.
verses.44:15: Peoples will recount their wisdom, and the assembly declares their praise.
verses.44:16: Enoch pleased the Lord and was taken up, an example of repentance to the generations.
verses.44:17: Noah was found perfect, righteous; in a time of wrath he became a replacement; therefore there was a remnant for the earth, therefore a flood came.
verses.44:18: Everlasting covenants were made with him, so that all flesh would not be blotted out by a flood.
verses.44:19: Abraham was a great father of a multitude of nations, and no one was found like him in glory,
verses.44:20: who kept the law of the Most High, and entered into a covenant with Him, and in his flesh he established a covenant, and in testing he was found faithful.
verses.44:21: Therefore by an oath He established for him that nations would be blessed in his offspring, to multiply him like the dust of the earth, and like the stars to exalt his offspring, and to cause them to inherit from sea to sea and from the river to the end of the earth.
verses.44:22: And in Isaac He likewise established, because of Abraham his father, the blessing of all people and the covenant,
verses.44:23: and caused them to rest upon the head of Jacob; He acknowledged him in His blessings, and gave it to him as an inheritance; and He divided his portions; among twelve tribes He distributed them.
verses.45:1: And He brought forth from him a man of mercy, finding favor in the eyes of all flesh, beloved by God and people, Moses, whose memorial is in blessings.
verses.45:2: He made him like the glory of the holy ones, and He magnified him in the terrors of enemies.
verses.45:3: By his words He caused signs to cease; He glorified him in the presence of kings. He gave him commands for His people, and He showed him part of His glory.
verses.45:4: In his faithfulness and meekness He sanctified him; He chose him out of all flesh.
verses.45:5: He made him hear His voice, and He led him into the thick darkness, and He gave him commandments face to face, a law of life and knowledge, to teach Jacob a covenant, and His judgments to Israel.
verses.45:6: He exalted Aaron, a holy one like him, his brother, from the tribe of Levi.
verses.45:7: He established him as an everlasting covenant, and He gave him the priesthood of the people. He blessed him with fine adornment, and He wrapped him in a vestment of glory.
verses.45:8: He clothed him with perfection of splendor, and He strengthened him with articles of strength: undergarments, a full-length robe, and a shoulder-garment.
verses.45:9: And He encircled him with pomegranates, with very many golden bells all around, to ring out a sound at his steps, to make a ringing heard in the temple for a memorial to the sons of His people;
verses.45:10: with a holy garment, with gold and blue and purple, of the works of an embroiderer, with an oracle of judgment, with manifestations of truth,
verses.45:11: with twisted scarlet, the work of a craftsman, with precious stones of seal engraving, in a setting of gold, of the works of a stone-engraver, for a memorial in an engraved inscription according to the number of the tribes of Israel;
verses.45:12: a golden crown upon a turban, an engraving of a seal of holiness, a splendor of honor, a work of strength, desires of the eyes, adorned. Beautiful things,
verses.45:13: before him none like them had existed; never has an outsider put them on, except his sons alone, and his descendants continually.
verses.45:14: His sacrifice will be wholly burned twice every day continually.
verses.45:15: Moses filled his hands and anointed him with holy oil; it became for him an eternal covenant, and in his seed during the days of heaven, to minister to Him and at the same time to serve as priest, and to bless His people in the name.
verses.45:16: He chose him from every living being, to offer a burnt offering to the Lord, incense and a pleasing aroma for a memorial, to make atonement for Your people.
verses.45:17: He set him in His commandments, with authority in covenants of judgments, to teach Jacob the testimonies, and in His law to call Israel.
verses.45:18: Strangers rose up together against him and were jealous of him in the wilderness, the men around Dathan and Abiram and the assembly of Korah, in fury and wrath.
verses.45:19: The Lord saw and was not pleased, and they were brought to an end in the fury of wrath. He worked wonders against them, to consume them in the fire of His flame.
verses.45:20: And He added glory to Aaron, and He gave him an inheritance. He allotted to them the firstfruits of the first produce; He prepared bread in abundance for them first.
verses.45:21: For indeed they will eat the sacrifices of the Lord, which He gave both to him and to his seed.
verses.45:22: Yet in the land of the people he will not inherit, and there is no portion for him among the people; for He Himself is your portion, an inheritance.
verses.45:23: And Phinehas son of Eleazar is third in glory, by being zealous in the fear of the Lord and taking his stand in the turning away of the people in the goodness of the eagerness of his soul; and he made atonement for Israel.
verses.45:24: Therefore a covenant of peace was established for him, to be leader of the sanctuary and for his people, so that the greatness of the priesthood might belong to him and to his seed forever.
verses.45:25: And a covenant for David, a son from the tribe of Judah: the inheritance of a king is of a son from a son alone; the inheritance of Aaron is also for his seed.
verses.45:26: May He give you wisdom in your heart to judge His people in righteousness, so that their good things may not vanish, and give their glory to their generations.
verses.46:1: Mighty in wars was Joshua son of Nun, and the successor of Moses in prophecies, who became according to his name great for the salvation of His chosen ones, to take vengeance on enemies rising up, so that he might give Israel an inheritance.
verses.46:2: How glorified he was in raising his hands and in turning a sword against cities!
verses.46:3: Who before him stood like this? For the Lord Himself brought on the enemies.
verses.46:4: Did not the sun turn back by his hand, and one day become as two?
verses.46:5: He called upon the Most High, the Mighty One, when enemies pressed him all around; and the great Lord answered them
verses.46:6: with hailstones of mighty power. He hurled down war upon a nation, and on the descent He destroyed those who resisted, so that the nations might know their full armor, that his war was before the Lord; for indeed he followed after the Mighty One.
verses.46:7: And in the days of Moses he showed mercy, he and Caleb son of Jephunneh, to stand against an enemy, to hold back the people from sin, and to quiet a grumbling of wickedness.
verses.46:8: And they, being two, were preserved out of six hundred thousand foot soldiers, to bring them into an inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.46:9: And the Lord gave Caleb strength, and until old age it remained with him, so that he went up onto the height of the land, and his seed possessed an inheritance,
verses.46:10: so that all the sons of Israel might see that it is good to walk after the Lord.
verses.46:11: And the judges, each by his own name, all whose heart did not prostitute itself and all who did not turn away from the Lord, may their memorial be in blessings.
verses.46:12: May their bones flourish again from their place, and may their name be renewed upon the sons of their glorified ones.
verses.46:13: Beloved by his Lord, a prophet of the Lord appointed a king and anointed rulers over His people.
verses.46:14: In the law of the Lord he judged the assembly, and the Lord visited Jacob.
verses.46:15: By his faithfulness he was proved a prophet, and he was known by his faithfulness to be faithful in vision.
verses.46:16: And he called upon the Lord, the Mighty One, when his enemies pressed him all around, with the offering of a nursing lamb.
verses.46:17: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and with a great sound He made His voice heard,
verses.46:18: and He wiped out the leaders of the Tyrians and all the rulers of the Philistines.
verses.46:19: And before the time of eternal sleep he testified before the Lord and the anointed one, "Money, even down to sandals, I have not taken from any flesh." And no one accused him.
verses.46:20: And after he had fallen asleep he prophesied and showed the king his end, and he lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the lawlessness of the people.
verses.47:1: And after him Nathan arose to prophesy in the days of David.
verses.47:2: Just as the fat set apart from the peace offering, so was David from the sons of Israel.
verses.47:3: With lions he played as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the sheep.
verses.47:4: In his youth, did he not kill a giant, and remove reproach from the people by raising his hand with a slingstone and bringing down the arrogance of Goliath?
verses.47:5: For he called upon the Lord, the Most High, and He gave might in his right hand to remove a man in war; He will lift up the horn of His people.
verses.47:6: So He glorified him for ten thousands, and praised him with the blessings of the Lord, when a diadem of glory was brought to him.
verses.47:7: For he wiped out enemies all around, and he brought to nothing the Philistines, the adversaries; to this day he shattered their horn.
verses.47:8: In every work of his he gave thanksgiving to the Holy One, the Most High, with a word of glory; with all his heart he sang hymns and loved the One who made him.
verses.47:9: And he stationed psalm-singers in front of the altar, and by their sound to make melodies sweet.
verses.47:10: He gave beauty to the festivals, and he adorned the seasons to completion, while they praised His holy name and from morning the sanctuary resounded.
verses.47:11: The Lord took away his sins, and lifted up his horn forever, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.
verses.47:12: After him a knowledgeable son arose, and because of him he dwelt in spaciousness.
verses.47:13: Solomon reigned in days of peace, to whom God gave rest all around, so that he might establish a house for His name and prepare a sanctuary forever.
verses.47:14: How wise you became in your youth, and you were filled like a river with understanding!
verses.47:15: Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with parables of riddles.
verses.47:16: To distant islands your name reached, and you were loved in your peace.
verses.47:17: For songs and proverbs and parables and for interpretation, lands marveled at you.
verses.47:18: In the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin, and like lead you multiplied silver.
verses.47:19: You laid your loins beside women, and you were brought under dominion in your body.
verses.47:20: You put a blemish on your glory, and you profaned your seed, so as to bring wrath upon your children, and I was grieved over your folly,
verses.47:21: that sovereignty became split in two, and a disobedient kingdom ruled out of Ephraim.
verses.47:22: But the Lord will never forsake His mercy, and nothing of His works will ever perish; nor will He ever blot out the descendants of His chosen one, and the seed of the one who loved Him He will never remove. And to Jacob He gave a remnant, and to David a root from himself.
verses.47:23: And Solomon rested with the fathers, and he left behind after him from his seed the folly of the people and one lacking in understanding, Rehoboam, who drove the people away by his counsel, and Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin and gave to Ephraim a way of sin.
verses.47:24: And their sins were greatly multiplied, so as to drive them away from their land;
verses.47:25: and they sought out every wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.
verses.48:1: And Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch.
verses.48:2: He brought a famine upon them, and by his zeal he made them few.
verses.48:3: By the word of the Lord he held back heaven; thus he brought down fire three times.
verses.48:4: How you were glorified, Elijah, in your wondrous deeds! And who is like you to boast?
verses.48:5: He who raised a dead person from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High;
verses.48:6: he who brought down kings to destruction and honored men from their bed;
verses.48:7: hearing rebuke at Sinai and judgments of vengeance at Horeb;
verses.48:8: he who anointed kings for retribution, and prophets as successors after him;
verses.48:9: he who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses;
verses.48:10: he who was recorded in rebukes for appointed times, to calm wrath before fury, and to turn the heart of a father to a son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
verses.48:11: Blessed are those who saw you and those who have been adorned in love, for we also will surely live.
verses.48:12: It was Elijah who was covered in a whirlwind, and Elisha was filled with his spirit; and in his days he was not shaken by a ruler, and no one overpowered him.
verses.48:13: No matter surpassed him, and in sleep his body prophesied;
verses.48:14: and in his life he performed wonders, and in death his works were wondrous.
verses.48:15: In all these things the people did not repent, and they did not turn away from their sins, until they were carried off as plunder from their land and were scattered in all the earth; and the people were left very few, and a ruler for the house of David.
verses.48:16: Some of them did what was pleasing, while others multiplied sins.
verses.48:17: Hezekiah fortified his city and brought Gog into their midst; he dug through hard rock with iron and built cisterns for water.
verses.48:18: In his days Sennacherib came up and sent Rabshakeh, and he departed; and his hand rose up against Zion, and he boasted greatly in his arrogance.
verses.48:19: Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered labor pains like women giving birth;
verses.48:20: and they called upon the merciful Lord, stretching out their hands to Him. And the Holy One from heaven quickly heard them and redeemed them by the hand of Isaiah.
verses.48:21: He struck the camp of the Assyrians, and His angel wiped them out.
verses.48:22: For Hezekiah did what was pleasing to the Lord and held strong in the ways of David his father, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, great and faithful in his vision.
verses.48:23: In his days the sun went backward, and he added life to the king.
verses.48:24: By a great spirit he saw the last things and comforted those who mourned in Zion.
verses.48:25: He showed what was to come until the end of the age, and the hidden things before they came about.
verses.49:1: The memorial of Josiah is like a blending of incense, prepared by the work of a perfumer; in every mouth it will be sweet like honey, and like music at a banquet of wine.
verses.49:2: He himself was directed rightly in the turning back of the people, and he removed the abominations of lawlessness.
verses.49:3: He directed his heart toward the Lord; in the days of lawless men he strengthened godliness.
verses.49:4: Apart from David and Hezekiah and Josiah, all of them committed trespass; for they forsook the law of the Most High; the kings of Judah came to an end.
verses.49:5: For they gave their horn to others and their glory to a foreign nation;
verses.49:6: it burned the chosen city of the sanctuary, and they made its streets desolate by the hand of Jeremiah.
verses.49:7: For they afflicted him, yet he was consecrated as a prophet in the womb, to uproot and to afflict and to destroy, likewise to build and to plant.
verses.49:8: It was Ezekiel who saw a vision of glory, which He showed him upon a chariot of cherubim;
verses.49:9: for he also remembered the enemies in a rainstorm, and to do good to those who direct their ways straight.
verses.49:10: And may the bones of the twelve prophets sprout again from their place. Now He comforted Jacob and redeemed them in faithfulness of hope.
verses.49:11: How are we to magnify Zerubbabel? And he himself is like a signet ring on a right hand;
verses.49:12: so also is Joshua son of Jozadak, who in their days built a house and exalted a holy people to the Lord, prepared for eternal glory.
verses.49:13: And they maintain for a long time the memorial of the one who raised up for us fallen walls, and set up gates and bars, and rebuilt our ruins.
verses.49:14: Not even one was created on the earth such a one as Enoch, for he himself was taken up from the earth.
verses.49:15: And Joseph was born a man, a leader of brothers, a support of the people, and his bones were cared for.
verses.49:16: Shem and Seth were glorified among people, and above every living creature in creation was Adam.
verses.50:1: It was Simon son of Onias, the high priest, who in his life repaired the house and in his days strengthened the temple;
verses.50:2: and by him was laid the foundation of the height of the double wall, the high retaining wall of the temple enclosure;
verses.50:3: in his days a reservoir of water was diminished, bronze like the sea in circumference;
verses.50:4: he who cared for his people against downfall, and strengthened the city in a siege.
verses.50:5: How he was glorified in the encircling of the people, on coming out of the house of the curtain:
verses.50:6: like the morning star in the midst of a cloud, like the full moon in its days;
verses.50:7: like the sun shining forth upon the temple of the Most High, and like a rainbow gleaming in clouds of glory;
verses.50:8: like a blossom of roses in the days of spring, like lilies by outlets of water, like a shoot of Lebanon in the days of summer;
verses.50:9: like fire and frankincense upon a censer, like a vessel of solid hammered gold adorned with every precious stone;
verses.50:10: like an olive tree putting forth fruit, and like a cypress lifted high in the clouds,
verses.50:11: when he took up the robe of glory and clothed himself in the perfection of splendor, at the ascent of the holy altar he glorified the enclosure of the sanctuary.
verses.50:12: And when he received the portions from the hands of the priests, while he himself stood beside the hearth of the altar, all around he himself was a crown of brothers, like a shoot of cedar in Lebanon, and they surrounded him like trunks of palm trees;
verses.50:13: and all the sons of Aaron were in their glory, and the offering of the Lord was in their hands before the whole assembly of Israel;
verses.50:14: and serving to completion at the altars, to arrange the offering of the Most High, the Almighty,
verses.50:15: he stretched out his hand to the libation cup and poured a drink offering from the blood of the grape; he poured out at the foundations of the altar a sweet-smelling aroma to the Most High, the King of all.
verses.50:16: Then the sons of Aaron shouted aloud; they sounded on hammered trumpets and made a loud sound to be heard for a memorial before the Most High.
verses.50:17: Then all the people hurried together and fell face down on the ground to worship their Lord, Almighty God, the Most High.
verses.50:18: And the singers praised with their voices; in the vast house melody was made sweet.
verses.50:19: And the people implored the Lord, the Most High, in prayer before the Merciful One, until the order of the Lord was completed and they finished His service.
verses.50:20: Then coming down, he lifted up his hands over the whole assembly of the sons of Israel, to give blessing to the Lord from his lips and to boast in His name.
verses.50:21: And a second time he bowed in worship to show forth the blessing from the Most High.
verses.50:22: And now bless God, all of you, who does great things everywhere, who exalts our days from the womb and deals with us according to His mercy.
verses.50:23: May He grant you gladness of heart, and may there be peace in our days in Israel as in the days of old;
verses.50:24: may He entrust His mercy to us, and in His days may He redeem us.
verses.50:25: Two nations my soul loathes, and the third is not a nation:
verses.50:26: those who dwell on Mount Samaria, the Philistines, and the foolish people who live in Shechem.
verses.50:27: Instruction of understanding and knowledge I have inscribed in this book, Jesus son of Sirach Eleazar, the Jerusalemite, who poured forth wisdom from his heart.
verses.50:28: Blessed is the one who will occupy himself with these things, and laying them upon his heart, he will become wise;
verses.50:29: for if he does them, he will be strong for all things, because the light of the Lord is his path.
verses.51:1: A prayer of Jesus son of Sirach. I will give thanks to You, Lord, King, and I will praise You, God my Savior; I give thanks to Your name,
verses.51:2: for You became a protector and helper to me, and You redeemed my body from destruction and from the snare of a tongue's slander, from lips that work falsehood, and before those standing by, You became a helper,
verses.51:3: and You redeemed me, according to the abundance of Your mercy and name, from gnashing jaws ready for food, from the hand of those seeking my life, from the many afflictions that I had,
verses.51:4: from the suffocation of a blaze all around, and from the midst of a fire that I did not kindle,
verses.51:5: from the depth of the belly of Hades, and from an unclean tongue and a false word.
verses.51:6: To a king, the slander of an unrighteous tongue; my soul praised to the point of death, and my life was very near Hades below.
verses.51:7: They surrounded me on every side, and there was no one helping; I was looking for the assistance of men, and there was none.
verses.51:8: And I remembered Your mercy, Lord, and Your working from eternity, that You will rescue those who wait for You, and You save them from the hand of the nations.
verses.51:9: And I lifted up my supplication on the earth, and I pleaded for deliverance from death.
verses.51:10: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my lord, not to forsake me in days of affliction, in a time of arrogant acts, of helplessness.
verses.51:12: For You saved me from destruction, and You rescued me from an evil time; therefore I will give thanks and praise You, and I will bless the name of the Lord.
verses.51:13: While I was still young, before I wandered, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.
verses.51:14: Before the temple I asked for her, and to the very end I will seek her out.
verses.51:15: From the blossom, as the grape ripens, my heart rejoiced in her; my foot stepped in uprightness; from my youth I tracked her.
verses.51:16: I inclined my ear a little and received her, and I found for myself much instruction.
verses.51:17: Progress came to me in her; to Him who gives me wisdom I will give glory.
verses.51:18: For I resolved to put her into practice, and I was zealous for the good, and I will never be ashamed.
verses.51:19: My soul has wrestled in her, and in the practice of hunger I was strict; I stretched out my hands toward the height, and I mourned the acts of ignorance concerning her.
verses.51:20: I directed my soul toward her; I acquired a heart with them from the beginning, and in purification I found her; therefore I will never be forsaken.
verses.51:21: And my innermost being was stirred to seek her out; therefore I acquired a good possession.
verses.51:22: The Lord gave me a tongue as my reward, and with it I will praise Him.
verses.51:23: Draw near to me, you uninstructed, and lodge in the house of instruction.
verses.51:24: And because you say that you are lacking in these things, and your souls thirst greatly,
verses.51:25: I opened my mouth and spoke: "Acquire for yourselves without silver;
verses.51:26: put your neck under a yoke, and let your soul receive instruction; she is near to be found.
verses.51:27: See with your eyes that I labored a little, and I found for myself much rest.
